claude_proposed_widenings.name: PassiveOperation.trigger.post_save_spell_outcome
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ring has an automatic rider after a successful saving throw against a qualifying spell, but passive magic-item operations currently only support elapsed-time triggers.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you succeed on the save for a spell of level 7 or lower, the spell has no effect on you.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: TriggeredReactionAbilityMechanics without required item resource/resetCadence
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ring's deflection rider spends only the wearer's Reaction and has no charge pool or recharge cadence, so the current triggered-reaction magic-item shape would force a fake resource.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to deflect the spell back at the spell's caster
